name: Business Source Extraction Playbooks
purpose: Route a raw business source URL to the smallest source-specific evidence playbook before Business Source Report creation.
sharedRules: Do not claim a source was inspected when access is blocked.
Copy exact business values without normalization when they are intended for source-of-truth use.
Reviews selected for use remain verbatim, including punctuation, casing, typos, emoji and blank lines.
Record asset provenance and an explicit asset policy before build planning.
Unsupported fields are omitted or left empty; never create placeholder business records.
If source types conflict, preserve each source independently and resolve the conflict explicitly rather than silently picking one.
